applicability_groups.raw_text: Applicability: Airbus A310-203, A310-203C, A310-204, A310-221, A310-222, A310-304, A310-308, A310-322, A310-324 and A310-325 aeroplanes, all manufacturer serial numbers.

definitions.definition_text: For the purpose of this AD, the following definitions apply: The Variation: Airbus A310 Airworthiness Limitations Section (ALS) Part 4 System Equipment Maintenance Requirements (SEMR) Revision 03 Variation 3.4. The AMP: The Aircraft Maintenance Programme (AMP) contains the tasks on the basis of which the scheduled maintenance is conducted to ensure the continuing airworthiness of each operated aeroplane. For aeroplane operated under EU regulation the operator or the owner ensures compliance with the AMP as stipulated in Commission Regulation (EU) 1321/2014. unsafe_condition.raw_reason_text: Reason: The SEMR for the Airbus A310 aeroplanes, which are approved by EASA, are currently defined and published in the Airbus A310 ALS Part 4 document. These instructions have been identified as mandatory for continued airworthiness. Failure to accomplish these instructions could result in an unsafe condition. EASA previously issued AD 2017-0202, AD 2020-0267, AD 2022-0195 and AD 2023-0018, to require the actions described in Airbus A310 ALS Part 4 Revision 03, Variation 3.1, Variation 3.2 and Variation 3.3, respectively. Since those ADs were issued, Airbus published the Variation, as defined in this AD, which contains new and/or more restrictive tasks and limitations. These tasks and limitations are expected to be incorporated into Airbus A310 ALS Part 4 at the next revision. For the reason described above, this AD requires accomplishment of the actions specified in the Variation. EASA AD 2017-0202, AD 2020-0267, AD 2022-0195 and AD 2023-0018 are not superseded by this AD.

requirements.action_text: (1) From the effective date of this AD, accomplish the following actions, as specified in the Variation, as applicable to aeroplane model and depending on aeroplane configuration: (1.1) Replace each component before exceeding the applicable life limit (see Note 1 of this AD); and (1.2) Within the thresholds and intervals (see Note 1 of this AD), accomplish all applicable maintenance tasks. Where this AD requires a task which is already required per EASA AD 2017-0202, the instructions of the Variation invalidate the instructions of Airbus A310 ALS Part 4 Revision 03. Note 1: For the purpose of this AD, the limitations, thresholds and intervals as defined in the ‘Compliance Time’ page(s) of the Variation, include specific compliance times for certain items and tasks.
